name: glass-search-bar
title: Glass Search Bar
description: iOS 26 floating search pill on Liquid Glass. The pill swells a touch on focus, a clear button pops in with text, and an optional round glass cancel button (or a Cancel capsule) splits off beside it — grouped, so on iOS 26 the two melt together as it springs in. Leading / trailing slots fit a custom icon or a mic button. Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, blur or frosted glass everywhere else.
